import chess
fen = "r1bq1r2/1p3pp1/p1n1p3/3nPkbP/8/P1N5/1P2QPP1/R1B1K2R w KQ - 0 1"
board = chess.Board(fen)
# verify mates
for u in ['e2e4','g2g4','e2g4','e2f3','e2d3','e2c2']:
    m = chess.Move.from_uci(u)
    assert m in board.legal_moves, u
    board.push(m)
    print(u, 'check=', board.is_check(), 'mate=', board.is_checkmate(), 'legal black replies=', board.legal_moves.count() if not board.is_checkmate() else 0)
    if not board.is_checkmate():
        # list escapes
        for bm in list(board.legal_moves)[:10]:
            print('  escape', bm.uci())
    board.pop()
# also confirm no other mate in 1 among all legal moves
mates=[]
for m in board.legal_moves:
    board.push(m)
    if board.is_checkmate():
        mates.append(m.uci())
    board.pop()
print('all mates in 1:', sorted(mates))
PY"],"command":"bash","cwd":"/app","max_output_bytes":8000,"timeout_ms":30000}
